papers.headline: SBi3PCF: cosmology with Dark Energy Survey Year 3 cosmic shear
papers.summary: We present the first cosmic shear data analysis of the integrated 3-point correlation function (i3PCF), a higher-order weak lensing statistic, and the first simulation-based inference (SBI) analysis of a three-point cosmic shear correlation function on survey data.
papers.title: SBi3PCF: cosmology with Dark Energy Survey Year 3 cosmic shear

papers.headline: Beyond just a torus? Re-contextualising the AGN type paradigm using data-driven host galaxy quenching histories
papers.summary: The orientation of a dusty torus within a unified model explains the presence (Type-1) or absence (Type-2) of broad emission lines in Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) spectra.
papers.title: Beyond just a torus? Re-contextualising the AGN type paradigm using data-driven host galaxy quenching histories

papers.headline: SN 2019qem: decades of extreme mass loss before the explosion of a luminous, long-lived Type IIn supernova
papers.summary: We present the luminous, long-lived Type IIn SN 2019qem and use it to reconstruct how much mass its progenitor lost and when. We combine host-subtracted optical and mid-infrared photometry and 26 optical spectra from -22 to +699 d.
papers.title: SN 2019qem: decades of extreme mass loss before the explosion of a luminous, long-lived Type IIn supernova
